note: Brazil's Ministry of External Relations table of entry visas (updated 7 October 2026), its visit-visa column: visa exemption for up to 30, 60 or 90 days by nationality (90 within any 180 for the Schengen states and the others it marks so; the Mercosur and associated states' citizens may also enter on an identity card), a visa otherwise. Since 10 April 2025, by reciprocity, the United States', Canada's and Australia's nationals need a visa again, applied for online as an e-Visa. Taiwan's passports get visit visas valid up to five years for 90-day stays (no diplomatic relations), Kosovo's and the Sahrawi Republic's visas on other documents: taken as visas.
